summary: Iteration 11 — Frontend-only verification of the SoundMap REDESIGN Phase 2 Design Hub at /design. All 7 review scenarios pass with 100% success. (1) AI Home → click objective-design → navigates to /design; design-hub-title renders 'Nuevo proyecto' (empty state) and 'The Warehouse Club' after demo. design-hub-progress-container + design-hub-progress present. All 6 steps present: design-step-{room,pa,dsp,amps,monitors,patch}. (2) Each step has a clickable design-step-{id}-toggle. Room is auto-expanded on first load (firstUndone logic). Toggle collapses/expands correctly (verified 2 cycles on room + 1 cycle on dsp). Description text 'Aún no configuraste este paso...' shows for undone steps. design-step-room-open button ('Abrir editor') + design-step-room-quick button (label='Cargar demo') both render. (3) Clicking design-step-room-quick invokes loadDemoVenue(); title morphs to 'The Warehouse Club', all 4 room summary cells present with correct values: NOMBRE='The Warehouse Club', DIMENSIONES='32×22×6 m', RT60='2.67 s', CAPACIDAD='400 pax'. Steps room, pa, dsp, amps, monitors all show green checkmark (isDone=true); patch remains undone. Progress bar width = 83.33% (5/6) — exact match to spec. (4) design-step-room-open (before demo) navigates to /room-scan. (5) /design?tab=optimize shows design-hub-optimize-link with text 'Abrir Optimizer' at the right of the progress row; click navigates to /stage-map. (6) With demo loaded (5/6), design-hub-goto-perform and design-hub-goto-report are correctly NOT rendered (only appear at 6/6). (7) Regression preserved: /kiosk fullscreen with kiosk-root, /shared/dsp renders 'Preset DSP · Enlace inválido' fallback (valid, no shared preset), /settings shows replay-tour-btn, Ctrl+K opens command-palette-overlay and palette-item-design navigates to /design. Design impression: extremely minimal Apple/Linear aesthetic is intentional and coherent — negative space, 3px pink progress rail, 22px rounded step cards with subtle shadow ring on expand, tabular-nums for KPIs, green (#5BA777) checkmarks on done steps.
critical_code_review_comments: src/pages/design-hub/index.tsx L47-50: quickAction is only defined on the room step. When the review request says 'quick action Cargar demo cuando aplica', the current implementation only shows it on the FIRST step. This is fine functionally (loadDemoVenue populates ALL steps), but consider a comment clarifying this or an explicit `id === 'room'` guard for readability — right now the `!room` check is the only gate and future refactors might accidentally add quickAction to other steps.

src/pages/design-hub/index.tsx L108: useMemo deps include `loadDemoVenue` (a zustand action) — zustand actions are stable references so this dep is harmless, but it clutters the dep array. Consider removing it or hoisting the quickAction closure outside useMemo.

src/pages/design-hub/index.tsx L114: initial expanded state is `firstUndone?.id ?? steps[0].id`, computed ONCE. After loadDemoVenue() runs, firstUndone shifts to 'patch' but the expanded state stays on 'room' (as observed in test — room stays open showing all 4 KPIs). This is actually good UX (user sees the demo populated the room they were on), but if the intent was to auto-advance to the next undone step after a quick action, it would need a `useEffect` to sync. Verify with product intent.

src/pages/design-hub/index.tsx L237: data-testid uses `cell.key.toLowerCase()` — works for 'Nombre'→'nombre' etc., but any Spanish key with accents (e.g. 'Configuración') would produce a testid with accented chars that some CI runners handle inconsistently. Current keys ('Nombre','Dimensiones','RT60','Capacidad','Tops','Subs','Unidades','Modelo','Amps','Monitores','Mixer','Micros') are all safe.

src/pages/design-hub/index.tsx L282: terminal CTA only appears when `doneCount === steps.length` (6/6). Demo only reaches 5/6 because patch step requires mics OR mixers — but loadDemoVenue does NOT seed a mixer or mics. If the product intent is for the demo to be a fully-complete showcase (unblocking the perform CTA), consider adding a demo mixer + a couple of mics to the loadDemoVenue action in the store.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — 40/40 assertions PASS. All 7 review scenarios verified end-to-end. Zero pageerrors. Zero console errors. Cloudflare 429 mitigation (≥6s spacing between page.goto) held throughout.

seed_data_creation: Triggered loadDemoVenue() via clicking design-step-room-quick on /design to verify the done-state flow. This is the standard demo seed (The Warehouse Club, 32×22×6 m, RT60 2.67s, 400 pax).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview: https://soundmap-preview.preview.emergentagent.com. Cloudflare 429 mitigation still critical — use ≥6s between page.goto for dense sweeps. The Design Hub at /design auto-expands the first undone step on mount (state initialised once, not reactive to store changes) — good UX. After loadDemoVenue, the design reaches 5/6 (all except patch which needs mics/mixer); terminal CTAs (design-hub-goto-perform, design-hub-goto-report) correctly gated to 6/6 only. To force 6/6 in a future test, either add a manual mixer/mic via /channels or extend loadDemoVenue in the store to seed them. Design Hub is completely minimal by design per the review note — DO NOT report the sparse aesthetic as a bug. All previous 10 iterations passed; no regressions detected in this run (kiosk, shared/dsp, settings, command palette all intact).
rca of the issue: N/A — no defects. Phase 2 Design Hub implementation is functionally complete and matches the review spec 1:1. The 5 code-review comments above are polish/product-intent items, not blockers; the redesign passes UAT as-is.
